title: A work order given a new lead from Reassign or its page goes to the bottom
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 25 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • [User-B]: a second dispatcher with Work Orders create and edit at the same location, signed in in a second browser (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two").
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Aardvark Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Abbey Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Delta Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Echo Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Aardvark Co", "Abbey Co", "Bravo Co", "Delta Co", "Echo Co").
  • Work orders (Approved): lead Ben — Bravo Co, Delta Co; lead Cal — Aardvark Co, Abbey Co, Echo Co.
  • Nobody has reordered Ben's work at this location, so Ben's column starts in customer-name order: Bravo Co, Delta Co.
  • None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two"; skip if one exists) with a role that has Work Orders View and Create & Edit at this location. Record as [User-B] and sign them in in a second browser.
  3. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Aardvark Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Abbey Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Delta Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom Echo Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom" in Search — exactly 5 work orders show, all Approved: Bravo Co and Delta Co led by Ben; Aardvark Co, Abbey Co and Echo Co led by Cal. Board View shows Ben's column as Bravo Co, Delta Co. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Hover the Aardvark Co card in Cal's column and click its more-actions button (…).
  5. Click "Reassign lead technician".
  6. In the dialog pick Ben Bravo (and confirm if the dialog has a confirm button).
  7. Read the order of Ben's column.
  8. Open the Abbey Co work order, set Lead Technician to Ben Bravo on the work order page, then go back to Work Orders > All > Board View.
  9. Read the order of Ben's column.
  10. Drag the Echo Co card from Cal's column and drop it between Bravo Co and Delta Co in Ben's column.
  11. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  12. In the second browser, as the second dispatcher, open Work Orders > All, search "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom" and read Ben's work in Tech View and in Board View.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: Ben's column reads Bravo Co, Delta Co, Aardvark Co. Aardvark Co goes to the bottom, even though by customer name it would come first.
  • Step 9: Ben's column reads Bravo Co, Delta Co, Aardvark Co, Abbey Co. A lead set on the work order page also goes to the bottom.
  • Step 10: Echo Co lands where it was dropped. Ben's column reads Bravo Co, Echo Co, Delta Co, Aardvark Co, Abbey Co.
  • Steps 11 and 12: Tech View shows the same order in Ben's group, and the second dispatcher sees the same order in both views.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R14, S2-R6, read 8 Oct 2026. Starting order (customer name A to Z): Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-45 (29 Sep 2026). The PRD of 7 Oct changed the removal rule: DR-47 (29 Sep) had put a removed work order at the bottom of Unassigned; the 7 Oct PRD puts it in Unassigned in the initial sort, and this case follows the 7 Oct PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R14: “A work order that gets a new lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views. A work order dragged to a technician goes where it is dropped. Removing the lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or the detail page puts the work order in Unassigned in the initial sort, not at the bottom, so it is not lost behind every other unassigned work order. Going to the bottom applies only to work moved onto a technician. A work order created or split off with a lead keeps the initial sort (S9-R3).”
  • S2-R6: “Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
